UM_GREX_PanDA_1._execution_unit: One single-core pilot per job. The separate fixed submit template allocates 8 cores, 48000 MB and 720 minutes to eight concurrent pilots; those allocation resources are not the per-job fit limits.
UM_GREX_PanDA_1._lifetime: 2026-10-22: current jobs median 68 minutes, p99 about 120, observed max 164. A 12-hour allocation, 510-minute intake window with +/-30-minute spread, at least 180-minute final-job reserve and 5-minute startup allowance replace the old 5-hour allocation/180-minute floor. The deadline-v2 launcher clamps every child's maxtime and timefloor to the actual batch budget. Existing spooled workers retain their old executable and data; see REGULATION_AUDIT_2026-10-22.md.
UM_GREX_PanDA_1._why: GREX runs pull pilots since 2026-10-19 (docs/OSG_SUBMISSION.md). Recorded as push, the queue fell under the server's meanRSS guard (meanrss 4000): with the eAu jobs running near 5.7 GB in its 8-job slots, the server dispatched only jobs under 4000 MB, and the 10,125 waiting retries ask for 5400.

BNL_OSG_PanDA_1._why: Harvester on osgsub01 runs this queue's pilots in pull mode since 2026-10-19 (docs/OSG_SUBMISSION.md); CRIC still recorded push, which put it under the server's meanRSS guard for push queues (the guard that starved GREX on 2026-10-20). timefloor 120 (2026-10-21): with 0 every pilot ran one job and left (994 jobs on 994 pilots in two hours at BNL_OSG_EPIC_PROD_1), so a queue ran only while a batch of its pilots was at the front of the pool's line; a pilot now takes jobs for 120 minutes. corecount 1, maxrss 4096 (2026-10-21): the pilots are single-core and request 4096 MB since the 22 October regulation correction, while CRIC recorded 8 cores and 48,000 MB; the front's fit check and PCS readiness read the record, so the 5,400 MB eAu tasks 40856 and 40857 passed as fitting OSG and lost 55,824 jobs to memory kills on the two OSG queues in three days. 4096 is the default task declaration, which runs here.

BNL_OSG_EPIC_PROD_1._why: Harvester on osgsub01 runs this queue's pilots in pull mode since 2026-10-19 (docs/OSG_SUBMISSION.md); CRIC still recorded push, which put it under the server's meanRSS guard for push queues (the guard that starved GREX on 2026-10-20). timefloor 120 (2026-10-21): with 0 every pilot ran one job and left (994 jobs on 994 pilots in two hours at BNL_OSG_EPIC_PROD_1), so a queue ran only while a batch of its pilots was at the front of the pool's line; a pilot now takes jobs for 120 minutes.

JLAB_PanDA_1._why: The JLab farm through its own HTCondor-CE, osg-ce-2.jlab.org (account pandas-eic), with pull pilots from pandaharvester01 as at GREX. CRIC has no such queue, and Torre would not wait for one (2026-10-20). JLab's glidein slots in the OSG pool run only CLAS12 (START requires projectName clas12), so this is ePIC's only route to the JLab farm. Starts brokeroff: only jobs we place run there.
